# SGR: attributes, colours and underlines, read back from printed cells.

=== SGR 1 sets bold
source: esctest2 sgr.py test_SGR_Bold
input: \e[1mA
cursor: 1,2
style: 1,1 bold

=== SGR 0 and an empty SGR reset everything
source: xterm ctlseqs SGR Ps = 0
input: \e[1;3mA\e[mB\e[4;7mC\e[0mD
cursor: 1,5
style: 1,2 default
style: 1,4 default

=== Every common attribute sets and clears
source: xterm ctlseqs SGR Ps = 1-9, 21-29, 53, 55
input: \e[1;2;3;5;7;8;9;53mA\e[22;23;25;27;28;29;55mB
cursor: 1,3
style: 1,1 bold dim italic blink inverse hidden strike overline
style: 1,2 default

=== The 16 colours
source: xterm ctlseqs SGR Ps = 30-37, 40-47, 90-97, 100-107
input: \e[31;42mA\e[91;102mB\e[39;49mC
cursor: 1,4
style: 1,1 fg=1 bg=2
style: 1,2 fg=9 bg=10
style: 1,3 default

=== 256 colours in semicolon and colon forms
source: xterm ctlseqs SGR 38;5;Ps and 38:5:Ps
input: \e[38;5;196mA\e[48:5:21mB
cursor: 1,3
style: 1,1 fg=196
style: 1,2 fg=196 bg=21

=== Truecolour in semicolon and colon forms
source: xterm ctlseqs SGR 38;2;r;g;b and ITU T.416 38:2:cs:r:g:b
input: \e[38;2;1;2;3mA\e[m\e[48:2::4:5:6mB\e[m\e[48:2:7:8:9mC
cursor: 1,4
style: 1,1 fg=#010203
style: 1,2 bg=#040506
style: 1,3 bg=#070809

=== Parameters after a colour still apply
source: xterm ctlseqs SGR (parameters are processed left to right)
input: \e[38;5;1;1mA
cursor: 1,2
style: 1,1 bold fg=1

=== An out-of-range colour is ignored
source: xterm ctlseqs SGR 38;2 (components are 0-255)
input: \e[38;2;300;0;0mA
cursor: 1,2
style: 1,1 default

=== Underline shapes
source: xterm ctlseqs SGR 4, 21; kitty and VTE underline styles 4:0-5
input: \e[4mA\e[4:3mB\e[21mC\e[4:5mD\e[4:0mE\e[4m\e[24mF
cursor: 1,7
style: 1,1 ul=single
style: 1,2 ul=curly
style: 1,3 ul=double
style: 1,4 ul=dashed
style: 1,5 default
style: 1,6 default

=== Underline colour
source: VTE and xterm SGR 58 and 59
input: \e[4;58:5:9mA\e[58;2;10;20;30mB\e[59mC
cursor: 1,4
style: 1,1 ul=single ulc=9
style: 1,2 ul=single ulc=#0a141e
style: 1,3 ul=single

=== The pen survives cursor moves and line feeds
source: xterm ctlseqs SGR (character attributes belong to the cursor)
input: \e[7mA\r\nB
cursor: 2,2
style: 2,1 inverse
